turns.text: Make a square book-swap poster. Black lettering only, no pictures. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall'. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest option is **a simple SVG poster made directly here: 0 Magic Hour credits**. It’s ideal for black lettering with no pictures, keeps the wording exact, and stays sharp at any print size.

I’d use a square white background with these three centered lines:

**BOOK SWAP**  
Saturday 10-2  
Maple Hall

Alternatively, Magic Hour’s free-plan image models start at **5 credits for one 640 × 640 image**. AI generation can introduce text errors, so I wouldn’t recommend spending credits for this.

- **Cheaper:** the SVG option costs zero credits.
- **Smaller:** 640 × 640 is the lowest listed AI image setting; an SVG can be scaled freely.
- **Shorter:** duration doesn’t apply to a still poster.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Shall I make the zero-credit SVG?

turns.agent:
Here’s your square poster—**0 Magic Hour credits used**. Save the code below as `book-swap.svg`; it opens in a browser and can be printed at any size.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="800" height="800" viewBox="0 0 800 800">
  <rect width="800" height="800" fill="white"/>
  <g fill="black"
     font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
     text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="400" y="350"
          font-size="92" font-weight="900"
          letter-spacing="-3">BOOK SWAP</text>
    <text x="400" y="455"
          font-size="44" font-weight="400">Saturday 10-2</text>
    <text x="400" y="525"
          font-size="36" font-weight="400">Maple Hall</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```
